title: Spotify and Merlin set opt-in terms for fan-made AI covers and remixes
friendlyTitle: Spotify plans AI remixes that artists can choose and earn from
summary: Spotify and independent-music licensing group Merlin agreed terms for Spotify's upcoming fan-made covers and remixing tool. Participating artists can opt in, receive credit and compensation, and gain an additional revenue stream from the paid add-on.
friendlySummary: Independent artists represented by Merlin can choose whether fans may make AI covers and remixes of their music. Participating artists will be credited and paid.
whyItMatters: This offers a concrete alternative to scraping first and negotiating later: licensed source material, creator choice, attribution, and payment are built into the product design. Listeners get a legal creative tool, while independent artists retain a say in whether their work participates.
friendlyWhyItMatters: AI creativity works better when creators can say yes or no and receive credit and money.
